items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: We were in back with the orchestra with Jack Elliott and Allyn Ferguson.

ctx.x: Oh jeez, it’s heaven. It’s heavenly I mean it really was. Wow. I mean I never thought that would happen. And then Miles Davis, another one. I saw him in New York. You know we didn’t get to hang, it was a different situation. That was when I did the album “Dingo” with Miles. Do you know that album? And the story, and he was in the movie you know. And when I did that I had to be some — when you mentioned I had to be somebody you know, Lalo Schifrin — I mean Michel Legrand it was, and I go into the studio to do this…

him in New York, going back to New York and the Village, and once again it was a very brief meeting. I sat down next to him in a bar, or he came in, I was at the bar. We were in back with the orchestra with Jack Elliott and Allyn Ferguson. And we did it live at Studio 8H in New York. So we got there and got to the Village when we flew in and everything was closing. But we went into this one place, we went into the Brecker Brothers’ club and that was closed. They were all closed already. But this one club in the…

I have to tell you that you know you made me think, I’ll tell our viewers that we had a 2:00 my time appointment for the Zoom and you dinged me at ten of. And I got this flash of Joe Wilder. You know Joe?
